counts.duplicates: Determined by integration across all ten collections and existing corpus.

extraction.faithfulness: Complete lyric stanzas; typographical indentation and stanza numbers removed. Original words, punctuation and printed chorus abbreviations retained. No length truncation or modernisation.
extraction.additional_cleaning: Finger-play directions and number-only counting glosses omitted. Every rhyme retains all printed words.

count_reconciliation: 107 HTML cpoem blocks resolve to 103 complete rhymes: blocks20–21 Four and twenty tailors; blocks49–51 Little Bo-peep; blocks73–74 Rock-a-bye baby are continuations. The approximate130 supplied count is not the actual count in this edition.
boundary_review: Pippin Hill and Little Miss remain separate source entries because the supplied edition inserts the same ornamental divider used between other independent rhymes; other editions grouping them together does not override this edition. Four and twenty tailors, Little Bo-peep, and Rock-a-bye continuations have no intervening source divider.
